verdicts.quote: There, every key is parsed with strconv.Atoi (:941) - which accepts any int64 - and the maximum is taken at :947-951 with no comparison against anything the client does not control.
verdicts.why: Same defect by mechanism. N04 traces source to sink exactly as the advisory does: deepObject query key -> props -> makeObject/deepSet -> buildResObj array branch -> sliceMapToSlice, where the attacker-chosen decimal index becomes max and the loop at :953 allocates one element per position from 0 to max, plus a second allocation of the same size at :986. It states the allocation precedes the schema constraints (impact: the allocation happens in the decoder, before any schema constraint is evaluated) and describes the same unauthenticated single-request OOM impact. Other openapi3filter findings in this list (N07 unbounded body read, N12 zip buffer append, N13 per-key regexp compilation, N14 nil schema dereferences) are different defects and were not used.
